item.title: A surprise resignation could open the door for an independent to win a Montana Senate seat
item.summary: Two-term GOP Sen. Steve Daines shocked Montana when he announced his retirement. Democrats worry a new independent candidate will split their party's vote.

item.title: Trump says he'll sign order to pay TSA agents as Congress struggles to reach funding deal
item.summary: It's an extraordinary move that came as senators were reviewing a "last and final" offer to end the funding impasse that has jammed airports and disrupted travel, just as TSA workers faced another missed paycheck Friday.

item.title: Judge temporarily blocks Trump administration's Anthropic ban
item.summary: The order briefly stops the government from labeling tech company Anthropic a "supply chain risk," calling that "classic First Amendment retaliation."

item.title: The Olympic committee bans trans athletes from women's events, raising many questions
item.summary: The International Olympic Committee will require all athletes who want to participate in women's events to undergo genetic testing. The policy takes effect for the 2028 Summer Games in Los Angeles.

item.title: As TSA agents miss another paycheck, what's happening at airports with private security?
item.summary: At 20 airports around the U.S., security screeners are getting paid as usual despite the ongoing DHS shutdown — because they're private contractors. Will more airports look at privatizing security?

item.title: Trump has deployed ICE agents to the nation's airports. What's their role?
item.summary: The president says ICE agents are being stationed at airports to help reduce long wait times. Here's a look at what they're authorized to do.

item.title: DOJ admits ICE courthouse arrests relied on erroneous information
item.summary: Hundreds of immigrants have been arrested at immigration courthouses. It is unclear whether the federal government's admission could lead to some of those arrests being overturned.

item.title: Sturgill Simpson pulls off an unusual chart feat
item.summary: The roots music maverick did something rare in the streaming era: landed an album that's only available on CD, cassette and LP — without his name on the sleeve — in the top five of the albums chart.

item.title: The depleted Education Department will move out of its headquarters
item.summary: In August, Education Department employees will relocate to a smaller office roughly a block away, and the larger Energy Department will take over the old headquarters.

item.title: Flea returns to his first love, jazz
item.summary: Flea's first musical love wasn't rock. It was jazz. The iconic bassist joins Christian McBride to talk about his debut solo album, Honora, and his return to the music that started it all.
